Beyondscale: Shashank
ThinkByte: Pavan, Harsha Thota
Key Takeaways
The team discussed targeting specific industries such as Fintech, Health Tech, and Maritime Transport for their services, focusing on providing data solutions and automating workflows.
There was a consensus on the need to refine the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) to better target potential leads and improve email campaign effectiveness.
Shashank emphasized the importance of demonstrating monetary benefits and ROI to potential clients to enhance the appeal of their services.
The team agreed to use a mix of manual and automated efforts for lead generation, including leveraging LinkedIn and possibly Google Ads for more qualified leads.
Sandeep was tasked with preparing a document outlining the email process and target cohorts to streamline communication and improve campaign outcomes.
Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs)
Narrow down, clearly define ICPs to ensure focused, effective outreach efforts.
Define ICPs clearly across target segments to improve lead targeting, engagement, focusing on fintech, health tech, maritime transport, and ESG sectors.
Use a "sprint strategy" for targeted lead generation, focusing on specific pain points, industry needs.
Broad, undefined ICPs lead to challenges in targeting, ineffective communication with potential clients.
Fintech and KYC Data
Narrow down ICPs by focusing on specific fintech needs and pain points.
Focus on providing fintech companies with data services related to KYC, crime data, and customer intelligence to enhance credit scoring and trustworthiness assessments.
Broad ICP definitions lead to challenges targeting right fintech companies for data services, making outreach less effective.
Emphasize ROI, cost benefits in communications to attract potential clients, demonstrating value of solutions.
Health Tech and Workflow Automation
Automate health tech workflows using generative VA, reduce manual processes like billing, order execution, improve operational efficiency.
Broad ICP definitions make targeting relevant health tech companies difficult, resulting in less effective communication.
Demonstrate ROI, efficiency improvements, focusing on pain points like manual billing, order execution.
Utilize lead magnets, personalized outreach strategies to engage potential clients more effectively.
Maritime Transport and Tanker Management
Target ship pooling, tanker management companies with specialized solutions for financial transparency.
Develop application for maritime transport companies to manage transparency in profits, voyage data, and financial distributions among ship owners.
Lack of transparency in financial distributions, voyage data for ship owners in maritime transport sector.
Use Google Ads find leads, engage with companies needing technology solutions enhance transparency.
ESG Reporting in Fintech and Manufacturing
Focus on fintech, manufacturing sectors needing ESG data solutions, emphasizing sustainability, carbon footprint metrics.
Highlight underutilized budgets for ESG initiatives as potential opportunity for engagement.
Complex, varied sustainability metrics across industries make standardization challenging.
Develop software solutions for ESG data collection, reporting, focusing on sustainability metrics, carbon footprint calculations across industries.
Lead Generation and Email Campaigns
Utilize tools like Apollo, Beyondscale platform for email campaigns, tracking analytics.
Implement structured lead generation, email campaigns using tools like Apollo and Beyondscale’s platform to improve client engagement.
Lack of personalized outreach strategies, ineffective email responses due to broad targeting, lack of clear communication.
Develop comprehensive lead generation document outlining processes, communication strategies by Sandeep.
ROI and Cost Benefits in Communications
Emphasize ROI, cost benefits in communications, focusing on potential savings, improved efficiency for clients in fintech, health tech, maritime, ESG sectors.
Difficulty demonstrating ROI, cost benefits in outreach, leading to less effective client engagement.
Focus on ROI, cost benefits in communications to attract potential clients, demonstrating tangible benefits of solutions.
Highlight potential savings, efficiency improvements in lead communications to engage effectively.
